derivatives_aggregators.coverage: 30+ exchanges; includes CME in exchange breakdown

derivatives_disagreement.explanation: CoinGlass and TradRadar use different venue universes, update times and aggregation methods; funding signs differ and open interest differs by roughly 45%. CoinGlass USD OI fell while coin-denominated OI rose, so the unit basis matters.
competing_hypotheses: Falling USD open interest partly reflects the XRP price denominator while coin-denominated contracts increased.
New short exposure may be increasing in some venues while long deleveraging dominates others.
Funding-sign differences may reflect venue coverage and OI weighting rather than a single market-wide positioning state.
